units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 89b:13">Snh. 89ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>כך עונשו של ב׳ וכ׳</he> such is the punishment of the liar &c.; Ab. d’R. Nath. ch. XXX; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:3">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> <he>מה טיבו של ב׳ הזה</he>; v. <cite ref="I00295"><he>טִיב</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 49a:11">Kidd. 49ᵃ</cite> he who translates a Bible verse literally (v. <he>צורה</he>), <he>הרי זה ב׳</he> is a liar (misrepresenting the sense).

<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:15">Deut. R. s. 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>דברים של ב׳</he> fictitious words (mitigating the original report); <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 5:15">ib.</cite> <he>דברי ב׳</he>.—Pl. <cite ref="B00937"><he>בַּדָּאִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00937"><he>בַּדָּאִין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:7:2">Y. Gitt. IV, 46ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>נמצאו הדברים ב׳</he> things turned out to be false.
B. Bath. 74ᵃ; Snh. 110ᵃ; 110ᵇ Moses and his laws are true והן ב׳ and they (euphem. for we) are liars.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 2:1">Tosef. Keth. II, 1</cite> <he>ב׳ אנו</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>מבודין</he>) we have been telling a falsehood.
